measurement: Measure the circumference of the trunk at a level midway between the lowest ribs and the upper iliac crest while standing. Universal sizing fits waist circumferences 26 to 70 in. Select Slim for shorter torsos or Standard for average height. Belt extensions are required for waist circumferences larger than 50 in. Accommodates patient heights 5 ft 1 in. to 6 ft 5 in.
